HomePage.title: From an idea to your own app
HomePage.description: Start with the look. Shared components and a verified example keep the app easy to follow as it grows.
HomePage.exampleDescription: A task list, a form, and a state gallery in one place.
HomePage.exampleContent: The demo shows validation, safe error messages, and working with temporary data. Remove all of it once you start building your own features.
HomePage.footer: The look comes from shared components and the existing design tokens.

Gallery.title: State gallery
Gallery.description: A small showcase of the components in use. The states are shown side by side on purpose; nothing is being saved.
Gallery.buttonsDescription: A regular action, loading, and an unavailable action.
Gallery.toastDescription: This message uses the shared Base UI toast.
Gallery.feedbackDescription: A message should explain the result and the next step.
Gallery.errorTitle: The change could not be completed
Gallery.errorDescription: Try the action again. What you typed is kept.
Gallery.emptyDescription: New items appear after you submit the form.
Gallery.calendarDescription: Pick a day with the mouse or the arrow keys. The demo always starts in January 2026.
Gallery.dialogDescription: The Tab key keeps focus inside the dialog. Closing it returns focus to the button that opened it.
